summary: Use an Input Search to search a list, with a clear button that appears as people type and an optional hint below.

examples.purpose: Find a payee, the guide's In context: a Card holding a VStack with Input Search over the payee rows (List Items with the payee's name and mobile number). value="" stands for the screen's query, still empty, so every payee shows; onChangeText stands for the screen storing the query and filtering the rows as people type, and clearing the field gives all of them back.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <InputSearch
      value=""
      onChangeText={() => {}}
      placeholder="Search payees"
      accessibilityLabel="Search payees"
      supportText
      supportTextLabel="Try a name or mobile number"
    />
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" navArrow={false} title="Asha Rao" supportText="98765 43210" />
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" navArrow={false} title="Ravi Kumar" supportText="91234 56780" />
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" navArrow={false} title="Meera Shah" supportText="99887 76655" />
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: The screen filters the list as people type and restores it when they clear the field; Input Search only reports the text.

examples.purpose: A fund search with a hint, from the guide's Prompts and hints: the prompt names what people search, the hint gives an example of what works, and the accessibility label repeats the prompt. value and onChangeText stand for the screen's query state.

props.name: supportText
props.description: Off by default; turned on with no supportTextLabel, the hint reads “Support Text”. Declared: Default false, from the component source.

props.name: supportTextLabel
props.description: Default "Support Text", from the component source.

props.name: supportTextIcon
props.description: Icon name from the icon registry to render inside the support text (e.g. 'ic_info', 'ic_cart'). Defaults to 'ic_info'. Default "ic_info", from the component source.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The visible placeholder clears on focus. Declared: Placeholder shown when the field is empty. Pass a string for a static placeholder, or a string array (2+) to cycle with a vertical slide (2000ms dwell, 500ms ease-out). Styled by TextInput. Default "Search", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: Typing and clearing need value and onChangeText both.

props.name: trailing
props.description: The clear button shows while value is not empty and trailing is not passed; it calls onChangeText('').

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Without accessibilityLabel the placeholder names the input and keeps naming it while focused; a rotating placeholder names it after its first item.

props.name: ...Omit<RNTextInputProps, 'style' | 'onChangeText' | 'onFocus' | 'onBlur' | 'placeholder' | 'value'>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.
